<h2>Run One sjSDM CV Calibration Budget Rung</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Fits and scores every regularization candidate over cached prepared folds
for one or more repeats at one fixed iteration and sampling budget.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>run_sjsdm_cv_calibration_rung(
  data_candidates = NULL,
  list_prepared_folds = NULL,
  data_budget = NULL,
  sel_abiotic_formula = NULL,
  config_sjsdm_cv_fitting = NULL,
  repeat_ids = 1L,
  seed = 900723L,
  device = "gpu",
  candidate_fit_function = fit_sjsdm_cross_validation_candidate,
  predict_function = predict_sjsdm_probability_matrix,
  score_function = score_sjsdm_joint_tuning_predictions
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_candidates">data_candidates</code></td>
<td>
<p>Complete regularization candidate table.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="list_prepared_folds">list_prepared_folds</code></td>
<td>
<p>Cached fold records from [prepare_sjsdm_tuning_folds()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_budget">data_budget</code></td>
<td>
<p>One-row calibration ladder entry.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="sel_abiotic_formula">sel_abiotic_formula</code>, <code id="config_sjsdm_cv_fitting">config_sjsdm_cv_fitting</code></td>
<td>
<p>Model formula and validated structural CV fitting configuration.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="repeat_ids">repeat_ids</code></td>
<td>
<p>Integer repeats to execute.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="seed">seed</code>, <code id="device">device</code></td>
<td>
<p>Deterministic seed and fitting device.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="candidate_fit_function">candidate_fit_function</code>, <code id="predict_function">predict_function</code>, <code id="score_function">score_function</code></td>
<td>
<p>Injectable fitting, prediction, and scoring backends.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>List containing fold-level benchmark evidence and attempt-level provenance.
</p>
